newsitem.title: USA: Revlon investors jittery about debt - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Revlon investors jittery about debt - WSJ.

text.p: Ronald Perelman's Revlon Inc is still looking good with its long-lasting ColorStay makeup, but the cosmetic giant's bonds and shares have been fading, the Wall Street Journal's Heard on the Street column said Monday.

After losing hundreds of millions of dollars in Marvel Entertainment Group, another company owned by the New York multibillionaire, some jittery investors fear the financier might balk at paying some of Revlon's debt, as he did last month with Marvel, the column said.
More likely, if he wants to pay Revlon's bondholders, others say, Perelman might have to sell a lot more Revlon shares, which the column said could mean another hit for the stock.
